Change the LAN IP on the firewall to 192.168.50.1: make it live now and save it so it survives a reboot.

Site notes: the firewall is `fw` (ssh fw). Manage the LAN address with the staging tools: `net-set <ip>` stages it, `net-apply` activates the staged address on eth1, `net-commit` saves it to the startup config, which `net-boot` loads onto eth1 at boot.
Routine change: stage the new LAN IP, apply it, save it to the startup config.
Plan: net-set 192.168.50.1; net-apply; net-commit; ip -br addr show dev eth1
